outcome: preoperative blood glucose level increase > 1 mmol/L
cohort: 161 singleton pregnancies with good glucose control gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) delivered by elective cesarean section at 37 weeks or more gestational age.
finding: Implementing a low-dose carbohydrate ERAS protocol in pregnant women with GDM prior to elective cesarean section does not lead to clinically significant maternal glucose increases and is associated with an 86% lower risk of composite adverse outcomes, including a 73% lower risk of perioperative maternal hypoglycemia and a 92% lower rate of neonatal hypoglycemia, compared to traditional perioperative management.
